rv.q: Kokandy Productions redefines the cult classic of A Clockwork Orange with fresh theatrics and a visual performance that will stay with audiences long after leaving the theatre.

Perhaps he is a sort of modern-day monster , who selfishly does what he does no matter what or how others feel. In watching this cast of players, many taking on more than one role, we are taken away from our everyday life, and become onlookers to a twisted tale that, for some, may feel unrealistic and to others, horrific.
